show.title: Hero Ghar Jamai
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/hfbB93
show.description: Hero Ghar Jamai is a heartwarming dramedy that flips traditional roles, following a man who takes pride in running his home while his ambitious wife builds her career. Through humor, love, and everyday struggles, the show explores themes of equality, modern relationships, and breaking stereotypes. With relatable characters and witty moments, it celebrates partnership, resilience, and the evolving definition of family.
